consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1984-06-21 show at Kingswood Theater was a fun experience, highlighted by a unique encore featuring The Band. While the performance was not considered one of the best of the year, several standout moments, particularly in the first set, were praised.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 44 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific songs, there were also criticisms regarding the overall performance and sound quality, leading to a mixed sentiment.
